slides.texte_overlay:
how to not feel exhausted
every morning

1. open the curtains first

daylight is the clearest signal that the day has started.

2. keep a glass of water by the bed

drink it before you check anything.

3. same wake-up time, even on weekends

your body loves a schedule more than a lie-in.

4. put your alarm across the room

by the time you turn it off,
you're already standing up.

5. plan one thing to look forward to

a good breakfast, a new chapter,
a coffee by the window.
